items.quote: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
items.claim: Early in the morning, Abraham observed smoke rising from Sodom and Gomorrah in the manner of furnace smoke
items.mechanism: went up as the smoke of a furnace
